# My Car Advisor

Independent vehicle-shopping assistance by Ali Sayes. Not a lender. No guaranteed inventory, approval, APR or religious certification.

- [Vehicle finder](https://mycaradvisor.netlify.app/inventory/): Source listings when available; shoppers remain on this site.
